Civilization Color Coding:

                         
 

North European Sets: Goths, Teutons, Vikings, and Huns= Dark Green

                         
 

Far East Sets: Chinese, Japanese, Mongols, and Koreans=Pink

                         
 

Middle East Sets: Byzantines, Persians, Saracens, Turks, and Berbers=Blue

                         
 

Western European Sets: Britons, Celts, Franks, and Spanish=Red

                         
 

Amerindian Sets: Aztecs, Mayans, and Incans=Light Green

                         
 

Mediterranean Sets: Italians and Portuguese=Dark Teal

                         
 

Eastern European Sets: Magyars and Slavs=Purple

                         
 

African Sets: Ethiopians and Malians=Dark Gold

                         
 

Indian Set=Turquoise

                         
 

Southeast Asian Sets: Burmese, Khmer, Malay, Vietnamese=Orange

                         
                           
 

Ages:

                         
 

"I": Signifies Dark Age architectures. For example: "Barracks I" refers to the

                         
 

SLP of the Dark Age Barrack graphic. All Dark Age architecture is shared across the

                         
 

different types of civilizations.

                         
 

"II": Signifies Feudal Age architecture. For example: "North European Stable II"

                         
 

refers to the SLP of the Northern European Feudal Age Stable graphic.

                         
 

"III": Signifies Castle Age architecture. For example: "West European House III"

                         
 

refers to the SLP of the Western  European Castle Age House graphic.

                         
 

"IV": Signifies Imperial Age architecture. For example: "Middle East University IV"

                         
 

refers to the SLP of the Midle East Imperial Age University graphic. Note that most

                         
 

buildings do NOT have a unique Imperial Age graphic and just keep their graphics

                         
 

from the Castle Age. The exceptions being the Town Center, Market and University.

                         
                           
 

Bridge/Gate Positions:

                         
 

"(/)": This means that the bridge/gate SLP graphic is diagnal and extends from

                         
 

Southwest to Northeast when going from left to right.

                         
 

"(\)": This means that the bridge/gate SLP graphic is diagnal and extends from

                         
 

Northwest to Southeast when going from left to right.

                         
 

"(-)": This means that the gate SLP is horizontal.

                         
 

"(|)": This means that the gate SLP is vertical.

                         
                           
 

Miscellaneous:

                         
 

If the SLP name is highlighted in black with white text this means the SLP is invisible.

                         
 

In otherwords, you can't find it in any of the folders. Example: 270 is the Shadow of

                         
 

Northern European Monastery. You can't find this file in any of the DRS folders, but

                         
 

you can still mod OVER it by putting a file with the name "270" in your mod.
